page.overview:
Who is Dryca?

Dryca of Ghostwall is a gnome who lived in the Ghostlands of Xhorhas as late as the early 840s PD.

Dryca is a male nether gnome with a stocky build, a bald head, and purplish grey skin marked with angular tattoos on his arms, torso, and neck. He wore simple clothing: a white shirt and dark pants.

Dryca is a mysterious and secretive individual, and also cold-minded, able to make difficult decisions in order to protect his people. He also was somewhat loyal to the Bright Queen, even if not very devoutly.

Dryca was part of a nether gnome community in the Ghostlands. At some point in the last three centuries he met one of the last members of a lineage of champions of Kord that warded a passage to the Dreadnest, Lolth's layer in the Abyss. After the extinction of that line of trusted heros, Dryca became the only one with knowledge of said passage.
